redaction_policy.paths: Local workspace and home prefixes become <workspace> and <home>; private temporary directories become <temporary>; internal coordination paths become <internal-path>. System and toolchain paths are retained.
redaction_policy.notes: Free-form notes fields are omitted from copied JSON. Numeric values, hashes, sample order and measurement fields are unchanged.
redaction_policy.scope: Only selected historical macOS evidence is included. No binaries, profile data, cloud records or unfinished platform results.

transformations: Replaced one source link with the pinned upstream URL for nested documentation; measurement data unchanged
